title: Copy Architecture card
description: One copy formula. The fill-in template is the card: it prints verbatim on the back and is never trimmed, and a formula the source gives only as a taxonomy row says so in the template's place rather than being filled in from anywhere else.

formulaId.description: The source's own id, printed as the front kicker: the surface prefix and the formula's position in that surface's taxonomy.

surface.description: The operational surface the formula belongs on, from the taxonomy row.

mechanism.description: The dominant behavioural driver, from the taxonomy row. The back prints it beside the template; a card whose template leaves no room carries it in the rules file and the layout map names it.

scope.description: Target readability and structural scope, from the taxonomy row.

blueprint.description: Whether the source prints a full blueprint for this formula (proportion prose, template, example) or only the taxonomy row. Both tiers ship.

blueprintProse.description: The blueprint's proportion paragraph, verbatim after the declared LaTeX rendering. It prints in the rules and the surface resource, never on the card; null where the source prints no blueprint.

ratio.description: The component parts and their percentages, authored from the blueprint prose and checked against it: every label and percent must appear in blueprintProse. Absent where the prose states no percentages; the front then prints the scope line.

schematic.description: The figure's own label, from the committed layout map: the family's noun, the mark and the divisions. It prints under the drawing and names what the shape draws.

frontSize.description: The point size of the front line, from the layout map: 6.5 to 9. A card whose ratio line runs long is set smaller rather than cut.

frontLine.description: The line the front prints under the rule: the ratio rendered as labels and percentages where the source states them, otherwise the scope line.

template.description: The fill-in pattern, verbatim and joined from its lines, where the source prints one; null where it prints none. Never trimmed.

templateLines.description: The template's own lines, verbatim and in order; template is these joined by a single space. The back prints one line per entry, because ten of the twenty-two templates are lists of parts and flattening them loses the source's structure.

noTemplate.description: The deck's own sentence, printed under the same heading the template uses, saying the source prints no template for this formula. Present only on taxonomy-only cards; nothing is filled in for them.

example.description: The blueprint's bland and optimized rewrite. Illustrative, so it lives in the artifacts and never on the card; null where the source prints no blueprint.

bland.description: The control rewrite. It may be a single word: one blueprint's blank control is "Submit.", and a before state is not required to be a sentence.

figure.description: The drawing and the parameters it reads. The vocabulary is fixed by decks/copywriting/data/layout-map.json at the second checkpoint.
